plain: Conduct that is improper or breaks good manners.

webster.text: That which is unbecoming in language or manners; any action or behavior which is deemed a violation of modesty, or an offense to delicacy, as rude or wanton actions, obscene language, and whatever tends to excite a blush in a spectator.

example.quote: GERRY urged the indecency and pernicious tendency of dissolving in so slight a manner, the solemn obligations of the articles of confederation.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, September 10, 1787
